1.notes: Visa-free entry for stays up to 90 days for tourism or business. Passport must be valid for the duration of the stay.

2.notes: An Electronic Travel Authorisation must be obtained before departure. Approval is usually granted within three working days.

3.notes: Visa-free entry for stays up to 90 days. An SG Arrival Card must be submitted within three days of arrival.

4.notes: Business e-Visa required. Apply at least five working days before departure.

5.notes: A B-1 business visa is required. Interview appointment lead times vary by consulate; allow at least thirty days.

6.notes: Short-stay business visa required, applied for through an accredited agency. Allow seven working days.

7.notes: Entry visa required, usually issued within four working days through an authorised visa agent.

8.notes: Visa-free entry for stays up to 90 days.

9.notes: ESTA authorisation required under the Visa Waiver Programme.

10.notes: Visa-free entry for stays up to 90 days.

11.notes: ESTA authorisation required under the Visa Waiver Programme.

12.notes: Domestic travel. Government-issued photo identification is required at security.
